mapper.insert: INSERT INTO plan_version (version_no, factory_code, forecast_version_id, inventory_snapshot_id, shipment_batch_id, capacity_version_id, rule_version, current_week_start, input_checksum, result_checksum, status, auto_recalc_forecast, auto_recalc_inventory, created_by) VALUES (#{versionNo}, #{factoryCode}, #{forecastVersionId}, #{inventorySnapshotId}, #{shipmentBatchId}, #{capacityVersionId}, #{ruleVersion}, #{currentWeekStart}, #{inputChecksum}, #{resultChecksum}, #{status}, #{autoRecalcForecast}, #{autoRecalcInventory}, #{createdBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE plan_version SET status = #{status}, result_checksum = #{resultChecksum}, version_no = version_no WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM plan_version WHERE factory_code = #{factoryCode} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM plan_version WHERE factory_code = #{factoryCode} ORDER BY id DESC
